svg.text: provisions the VMs; creates each sandbox and
grants read and write on each volume; hands out
short-lived storage credentials, seeing both who
asks and what kind of compute asks
one cluster node — a VM in your cloud account
host-subnet IP for management, container-subnet IP for Spark
Linux user spark-6166…, low privilege, no metadata
Linux user spark-5a9e…, network egress controlled
reads tables and dbfs:/Volumes/… by URI — not through
internal fork of goofys; DBFS root and mounts,
not named publicly, and neither is where it runs: one daemon
checking each caller, or one per sandbox. Its limits — no
append, no random write — match goofys'
managed: Unity Catalog's location · external: a location
read and written by Spark directly
GET · whole-object PUT — the path every /Volumes byte takes
